मुख्य योिना-2021/िोन 'िी' की क्षेत्र ीय जिकास योिना में जनम्नजलजखत संिोधन करने का प्रस्ट् ताि करती है, जिसे सािविजनक िानकारी के जलए एतदद्वरा प्र काजित दकया िाता है। प्रस्ट् ताजित संिोधन के संबंध यदद दकसी ि्यजि को कोई आपजि हो/सुझाि देना हो तो, िह इस नोटिस के प्र कािन की जतजथ से तीस (30) ददनों की अिजध के भीतर ऑनलाइन पोिवल citzservices.dda.org.in या ई-मेल mpd2021.public@dda.org.in के माध्यम से या जलजखत रू प में आयुि एिं सजचि, डीडीए, 'बी' ब् लॉक , जिकास सदन, नई ददल्ली -110023 को अपनी आपजि/सुझाि भेि सकता है। आपजि या सुझाि देने िाले व्य जि अपना नाम, पता और िेलीफोन/संपकव नंबर/ई-मेल आईडी भी दें, िो पठनीय हो। प्रस्ट् ताजित संिोधन: अिजस्ट्थजत क्षेत्र फल (हेक्िेयर ) ददल्ली मुख्य योिना-2021/िोन िी की क्षेत्र ीय जिकास योिना के अनुसार मौिूदा भूजम उपयोग भूजम उपयोग पटरिर्ततत दकया गया सीमाएँ 1 2 3 4 5 AUTHORITY (Master Plan Section) PUBLIC NOTICE New Delhi, the 12th March, 2025 F.No. F.3(44)/2012-MP/E-File:PLG/0013/2022/-AD(PLG-ZONE G)AP-III.—The following modification which the Delhi Development Authority / Central Government proposes to make to the Master Plan for Delhi -2021 / Zonal Development Plan of Zone ‘G’ under Section 11-A of DD Act, 1957, is hereby published for public information. Any person having any objection/suggestion with respect to the proposed modification may send the objection / suggestion via online portal citzservices.dda.org.in or via e-mail to mpd2021.public@dda.org.in or in writing to the Commissioner-cum-Secretary, DDA, ‘B’ Block, Vikas Sadan, New Delhi-110023 within a period of thirty (30) days from the date of publication of this notice. The person making the objection or suggestion should also give his / her Name, Address and Telephone/Contact Number(s) / E-mail ID which should be readable. Proposed Modification: Location Area (Ha.) Existing Landuse as per MPD-2021/ZDP of Zone-G Land use changed to Boundaries 1 2 3 4 5 Vacant Land of RLDA at Rohtak Road, Shakurbasti falling in Zone-G 4.63 Ha 'Transportation' (Circulation-Rail)’ ‘Residential’ North: Shakurbasti Railway Station South: Rohtak Road East: Railway vacant land West: Railway vacant land The Text / Plan indicating the proposed modifications shall be available for inspection at the office of Deputy Director, Master Plan Section, DDA, 6th Floor, Vikas Minar, I.P. Estate, New Delhi-110002, on all working days within the period referred above. The text/plan indicating the proposed modifications is also available on the following link i.e. https://dda.gov.in/mpd-2021-public-notices-2025 and https://citzservices.dda.org.in. SURENDRA KUMAR MEENA, Commissioner-cum-Secy.
